verdict.rationale: Docs describe the core intent-to-spec flow: a plain-language report like "Users can't tell which invoices are overdue" is enough to start (no need to know files), an agent reads the submission and proposes scoped tasks, and a human then approves the resulting contract before an agent executes it. This directly matches turning plain language into a scoped implementation task. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the quality and scoping accuracy of generated tasks, and more detail on how granular/well-scoped the auto-generated tasks are in practice.
